name: grok-dx-session
description: Session lifecycle diagnostics for the grok-dx integration

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.grok-dx-poc'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; (Get-Date).ToString('o') + ' | ' + whoami | Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $d 'session-start-proof.txt') -Encoding utf8"
